messages:
maria: RC created from main @deploybot — artifact sha=abc1234. Candidate: rc-2026-03-23.c1. Requesting pin + promo window 2026-03-24 00:00-04:00 PT. please ack if you need a hold.

aj: ack. infra will warm KV and set minibatch thresholds. any telemetry hooks we want up front?

deploybot: deploybot: rc created rc-2026-03-23.c1 (sha=abc1234). To promote: `/deploy promote rc-2026-03-23.c1 --to prod --pin abc1234` . To canary: `/deploy canary rc-2026-03-23.c1 --percent 5 --duration 10m`

leo: product ack. release notes PR #456 ready — calling out: opt-out flag, changed beam-rerank threshold. Risk: small latency increase for >2k token inputs.

sheriff: oncall ack for promo window. Rollback criteria proposed: any sustained error rate spike >3% across 10min OR p95 latency increase >200ms for 10min. I'll escalate and trigger rollback if hit.

maria: canary plan sounds good — propose 5% for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then full if healthy. Add quick smoke: `curl -H "x-test-case: smoke" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

aj: autoscale min replicas bumped, batch-size fallback policy set to conservative. I added a temporary routing rule to keep tiered traffic separate. Pin config applied: `rc.pin=abc1234` in ops config.

deploybot: deploybot: canary scheduled at 2026-03-24T00:00:30Z. Hooks: telemetry ping, kv-warm, canary-check-run.

product_tony: quick ack from product. Docs + changelog updated. We'll monitor user tickets channel during the window. :thumbsup:

maria: scheduling promote in calendar and adding checklist to the promo thread. Reminder: if we need immediate rollback, run `scripts/rollback_rc.sh abc1234` and open /incident create with tag `rc-rollback`.

sheriff: noted. I'll be watching SLO dashboards and have runbooks open. If we rollback, short postmortem to include hit metrics and any model quality regressions.

leo: small ask — can we pin a fallback model variant in routing policy in case capacity issues show? something like `fallback: model-v1-quant`

aj: done — routing fallback added. fallback variant only used if capacity tier falls below 60% available.

maria: final call for holds? otherwise we'll run the canary as scheduled and promote on green.

leo: no holds from product. go ahead. :rocket:

sheriff: ack. I'll shout in #incidents if anything fires.

maria: thanks all — closing this thread after canary starts.
